In my town, everyone has a battery above their head.
When it hits zero, you fall asleep instantly. Anywhere.
Today my teacher was down to two percent.
He fell asleep at the board in the middle of a sentence.
Grandma hit zero percent at lunch.
Now she's snoring over her soup.
And Dad charges himself on the couch every night.
Only for me, everything is different.
My battery has been at one hundred percent since the day I was born.
I never get tired. Never.
Played Minecraft all night? One hundred percent.
Ran around the town square ten times? One hundred percent.
But tonight, I only pretended to be asleep.
Then Mom came into my room and sat down on my bed.
The battery above her head said: one percent.
And a thin light ran from her battery to mine.
My battery was never full on its own.
Mom had been giving me hers every single night.
Then she hit zero and fell asleep.
So I took her hand.
Ninety. Seventy. Fifty.
For the first time in my life, I was tired.
And it was the best feeling in the world.
